title: Display Case x Bare Bones
description: A Bare Bone retexture of the Display Case mod.
body:
## A Simple Display Case

![A showcase of the Display Case.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea8d3e924988f9f86480a491124dde7871a49084.png)

## Instructions

This resource pack requires [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones), and the [Display Case](https://modrinth.com/mod/displaycase) mod to work. Both made by awesome folks. 

## Contact

You can find me in the Bare Bones Discord Server. 

Username: venenoir

Display Name: Rosie

I have a [Google Issue Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexYWUHry04VcV9PAKD4-wxOazOoZSYTFQ6iMBtzwY4z45nSw/viewform?usp=dialog) for criticism and issue reports! Please feel free to leave constructive criticism and report issues here!
